Strategy: Extended scaled awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between a third of the item and twice the item lose a penalty of half the item, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that extended band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by avoiding more medium leftovers, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item / 2 if r - item > item / 3 and r - item <= 2 * item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Extended scaled awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/3, 2*item] by item/2, exact fit highest.
